effects.prompt: Untap up to 3 cogs you control?

_comment: Instant CARD -> ability_type PLAY (INSTANT would be an activated ability and never fire for a played card). Untap composed as TAP_TARGET (dict object target, record_as) + TAP_REF untap:true - the only untap path (no dedicated UNTAP effect); net effect correct (tapped cogs: tap cancels then untap clears; untapped cogs: tap then untap round-trips), wart: spurious TapEvent for untapped cogs (same shape as .drafts/draw_back_the_hammer_red.json). 'Cogs': no Cog subtype exists in the DB (verified scan), so name-substring 'Cog' over ARENA (permanents) matches Copper Cog, Golden Cog, Cognition Nodes - the cogwerx_workshop_blue precedent. GAP: 'up to 3' is approximated - the object-target pick loop is mandatory up to amount (effect_types.py:807-817), so accepting forces exactly min(3, pool) picks; choosing 1-2 of 3+ is not expressible (same gap documented in cogwerx_workshop_blue). The MAY wrapper lets the player decline entirely (0 cogs), honoring release note 2; the CARD_IN_ZONE gate means the prompt is not offered with no cogs.
